overall_strategy_summary: WisdomTree has pivoted from a traditional ETP provider to a digital-first financial platform. Core business remains ETFs/ETPs ($110B+ AUM) but digital assets are now a core strategic pillar. 15 tokenized funds, WisdomTree Prime retail wallet, WisdomTree Connect institutional platform, USDW stablecoin, BNY BaaS partnership, NYDFS trust charter. Grew tokenized AUM from $30M to $770M in 2025. Multi-chain strategy (Stellar, Ethereum, L2s). GENIUS Act compliance as competitive moat.
